card.name: Verb after amount words like little
card.fires_on: The verb (usually "is", also "was", "remain", "apse") right after a quantity phrase such as "little", "more", "not enough information" or "less than 6 hours". The subject is an amount of something and the verb is about to be followed by a state like known, available or needed.
